evidence_excerpts: Significantly greater shifts away from hard materialistic beliefs were found for those patients who showed a clinically meaningful response to psilocybin only ... versus those who showed a response to escitalopram (Z = 1.74, p = 0.041, g = 0.56, 90% CI [− 0.17, 1.26]).
text: Patients who clinically responded to psilocybin therapy showed greater shifts away from hard materialist beliefs than patients who responded to escitalopram.
